answer: To blunt sybil swarms, every new identity should post a slashable bond and collect attestations from five established, non-kin peers. Kinship is inferred from shared invite trees, correlated funding, and near-identical timing. A review prism splits those signals so a clone farm cannot vouch for itself. The voyage from registration to established status therefore costs both capital and uncorrelated social proof, and a lone lotus of genuine work outruns a thousand hollow accounts.
